proof_body:
by
  intro a h k x y ha
  rw [← Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs (y - k + 1 / (4 * a)), Real.sqrt_inj (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  have key : (x - h) ^ 2 + (y - k - 1 / (4 * a)) ^ 2 - (y - k + 1 / (4 * a)) ^ 2 = (a * (x - h) ^ 2 - (y - k)) / a := by
    field_simp
    ring
  constructor
  · intro e
    have hz : a * (x - h) ^ 2 - (y - k) = 0 := by linarith
    rw [hz, zero_div] at key
    linarith
  · intro e
    rw [e, sub_self] at key
    have := (div_eq_zero_iff.mp key.symm).resolve_right ha
    linarith
